_about: Retrieval gold set. Protocol note: these questions were written by the same author who tuned the retriever, after reading the knowledge base, so every number computed on them is an in-sample-adjacent, optimistic bound. Held-out protocol: a second person writes 30 questions from the product spec alone (never the passages), they are stored in eval/heldout.json, and numbers from that file are reported separately as blind. 'type' is vocab (reuses passage wording), paraphrase (different wording), or miss (out of scope: the right behaviour is no confident match). 'plural' (v3.2, audit N-06) asks with plural or inflected wording; 'targets' lists passages any one of which counts as a hit.
